name: RescueTime
description_en:
RescueTime is a product in the Time tracking category. Its directory profile covers Timesheet Management, Overtime Calculation, Offline Time Tracking, Mobile Time Tracking, Billable & Non-billable Hours, Automatic Time Capture, Employee Database.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.5.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: collect and review time records; store structured information about employees. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

RescueTime 属于工时管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括工时表管理、加班计算、离线工时跟踪、移动端工时跟踪、可计费与不可计费工时、自动工时记录、员工资料库。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.5.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：汇集并审核工时记录；集中保存结构化员工资料。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
